verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron is a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax and monitoring job runs [supabase-docs-9]. Supabase Queues adds durable, guaranteed-delivery messaging for job pipelines [supabase-docs-10]. For AI-native use, the live agent-skills catalog explicitly covers Cron and Queues, so agents can set these up [supabase-probe-rt-3]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably, and documented multi-step workflow orchestration beyond cron plus queues.
